Matunga.description: Matunga sits on both Central and Western suburban lines (Matunga + Matunga Road stations) with rapid access to Dadar, Sion and the Eastern Freeway toward South Mumbai and BKC. Active co-operative society redevelopment is reshaping the stock.

Matunga East.description: Matunga East is centred around the Central Line station and King Circle catchment. Eastern Freeway and Sion-BKC connector give strong east-west mobility; older CHS stock is undergoing selective redevelopment.

Matunga West.description: Matunga West benefits from Matunga Road (Western Line) station and proximity to Mahim / Bandra. Post-2000 and redeveloped stock commands a premium over older East-side cooperatives.

Matunga South.description: Southern edge of Matunga toward Dadar / Five Gardens. Shares dual-rail access and Eastern Freeway connectivity with the rest of the Matunga micro-market.

Pedder Road.description: Pedder Road is a prime South Mumbai residential corridor with Coastal Road access, proximity to Breach Candy / Cumballa Hill and strong demand for high-end apartments.
